messages:
jess (eng-releases): Drafting release notes for tomorrow's deploy (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Key bullets below — quick sanity check please. Planned pin: v2.3.1-rc5 (build 2026-03-19_2145). Need explicit rollback lane and confirm oncall handoff.

toby (eng): LGTM on the bullets. Two asks: pin a fallback variant (v2.2.8-quant) in routing policy in case of perf regression, and include a short note about the KV-cache migration step that may increase first-request latency. Deploybot needs a flag for 'fallback-route'.

morgan (product): For internal announce: audience = eng, support, sales. I can draft the blurb + link to playbook. Recommend embargo external comms for 72h after deploy. Also call out known UX changes so support can prep canned responses.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by @jess for 4301112222 -> cluster-prod-3 at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Canary plan: 1 node (10%) -> 50% -> 100%. Pin tag: rn-2026-03-20. Rollback command (if needed): `/rollback deploy 4301112222 --to v2.2.8-quant`. Use `--force` only after SRE signoff.

oncall (eng-sre): Confirming SLO thresholds to trigger automated rollback: p95 latency > 700ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% sustained for 3m. Also add an alert for KV cache warmup errors and slow tokenization. I'll be primary between 01:30-05:30 UTC, @toby you're backup.

jess (eng-releases): Draft RN bullets below (feel free to edit):
```
- Runtime upgrade: improved attention kernels -> ~15% lower token cost on long contexts.
- Model pin: v2.3.1-rc5 (default) with fallback v2.2.8-quant.
- Known impact: initial requests may see +200-600ms during KV-cache warmup (expected ~10-15 min).
- Observability: per-route tracing enabled; cost/latency dashboards updated.
- Rollback: automated based on SLOs; manual rollback steps in playbook (link below).
```
Internal announcement (short):
"Tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC: runtime & model pin rollout (v2.3.1-rc5). Expect short KV-cache warmup latency. SRE will monitor; fallback to v2.2.8-quant available. See playbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/rn-2026-03-20 and canned responses: https://internal.redwood/support/canned/rn-2026-03-20"

morgan (product): Nice. I'll copyedit and post the internal announce 90m before window, tagging support + sales. Can we add a single-line 'what to tell customers' snippet? Suggest: "We rolled out an optimizer that reduces token costs for long prompts; no action required."
